svg.title: Module rack — team and academic systems
svg.desc: 03 JOBCONNECT (FullStackAttack · Producto 4): Full-stack JavaScript job platform. Chain: HTML · Bootstrap · JS → Fetch → GraphQL · Apollo → Mongoose → MongoDB. Express server · auth & roles · Socket.io real time. TEAM OF 3 · UOC FP.450. 04 REPARAYA · LARAVEL (ReparaYa · Producto 3): Repair management migrated to Laravel. Chain: Blade views → Laravel 12 MVC → Eloquent ORM → MySQL 8. REST JSON API · B2B module · Docker · deployed to a UOC server. TEAM OF 3 · UOC FP.448. 05 REPARAYA · PHP (ReparaYa · Producto 2): Framework-less PHP repair management. Chain: public entry → PHP MVC core → PDO → MySQL 8. Apache · phpMyAdmin · Docker Compose environment. UOC FP.448. 06 BUGBUSTERS (BugBusters · Producto 2): Collaborative Java online-store logic. Chain: console view → controller → model · generics → in-memory data. MVC · OOP business rules · exceptions · JUnit tests. TEAM PROJECT · UOC.
svg.text: + Express server · auth & roles · Socket.io real time
+ REST JSON API · B2B module · Docker · deployed to a UOC server
+ MVC · OOP business rules · exceptions · JUnit tests
